hooks.command: skill=$(jq -r '.tool_input.skill // empty'); if [ "$skill" = "code-review" ]; then gitdir=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); git rev-parse HEAD > "$gitdir/last-code-review-sha"; fi 2>/dev/null || true

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|]) *(git[[:space:]]+push|gh[[:space:]]+pr[[:space:]]+create)'; then gitdir=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); current=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null); marker=$(cat "$gitdir/last-code-review-sha" 2>/dev/null); if [ "$current" != "$marker" ]; then jq -cn --arg sha "$current" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"allow",permissionDecisionReason:("Reminder: /code-review has not been run for the current commit (" + $sha + "). Run /code-review and address findings before this push/PR (CLAUDE.md workflow step 6).")}}'; fi; fi 2>/dev/null || true
